notes:
✓ Product tiles in the All tab no longer collapse — names, prices and stock are back
✓ Full screen button in the header, with the screen kept awake while it is on
✓ Nothing the till shows will knock it out of full screen
✓ Shift close-out now asks for total sales and total cash on hand separately
✓ Each figure is checked against what the till recorded, so an unrung sale shows up
✓ Dashboard cash drawer shows the declared sales figure and flags the ones that disagree
✓ An update now sticks — the old cached version no longer comes back on the next launch
✓ Deleted sales stay deleted, on every till
✓ Deleting sales for a date now says so plainly when the cloud had nothing matching
✓ Sales deleted on the Dashboard are cleared from the till on the next sync
✓ Ingredient stock is no longer deducted twice for one sale
✓ Restocking an ingredient no longer wipes out sales rung up while the form was open
✓ Renaming a product keeps its recipe, so stock keeps being deducted
✓ A product at zero stock no longer turns itself into Unlimited when edited
✓ Profit & Loss adds up — wastage, ingredient cost and salaries are all subtracted
✓ Net profit now includes cost of goods, and matches across Overview, Reports and P&L
✓ Per-product profit uses what the sale actually rang up, not the current price
✓ Wastage can be linked to an ingredient and deducts its stock
✓ Days-of-stock estimates use the sales history that exists, not a fixed week
✓ Sync buttons actually sync instead of reporting success and doing nothing
✓ A low stock alert of zero is kept instead of resetting to five
✓ Ingredient and product names with quotes or brackets no longer break the page
✓ One business is resolved the same way everywhere, so stock updates stop going missing
✓ A pre-seeded shop can only be claimed by its own owner
